queryCondition.queryText:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where FileName =~ "wmic.exe"
| where ProcessCommandLine has_all ("/node:", "process", "call", "create")
| project Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName, InitiatingProcessFileName, FileName, ProcessCommandLine, ReportId

alertTemplate.title: Remote Process Creation via WMIC
alertTemplate.description: Detects wmic.exe executing process call create against remote hosts (/node:), a living off the land lateral movement and execution technique covered in ASD/ACSC joint guidance. ISM controls: ISM-0580, ISM-1405, ISM-1621, ISM-1657. Advisories: acsc-2024-02-07-identifying-and-mitigating-living-off-the-land-techniques.
alertTemplate.recommendedActions: Verify whether the initiating account is authorised for remote WMI administration and inspect the target host for spawned processes (ISM controls: ISM-0580, ISM-1405, ISM-1621, ISM-1657; Advisories: acsc-2024-02-07-identifying-and-mitigating-living-off-the-land-techniques).
